style.styleTitle: Personalised White Memorial Feather Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: This Personalised White Feather Glass Bauble with Heart Tag is a beautiful memorial keepsake, perfect for remembering a loved one at Christmas. Inside each glass bauble rests a delicate white feather, symbolising peace, comfort, and the presence of those we miss. It is finished with a heart-shaped acrylic tag, engraved with the fixed words “Feathers appear when loved ones are near”. You can personalise the tag with two lines of text, up to 20 characters each, to create a truly meaningful tribute. As each bauble is handmade, slight variations such as small water marks may occur during the manufacturing process, making every piece unique. Please ensure the clear protective film is removed from the acrylic tag before use. A touching way to cherish special memories, this bauble makes a timeless addition to the Christmas tree and a heartfelt reminder of loved ones who remain close in spirit.
